script_text: Leo, July 2026 is about to flip your world upside down—Jupiter is smashing into your 10th House in Cancer with a fiery conjunction to Saturn, and you cannot ignore this cosmic earthquake. Your career gets a dual charge: Saturn in Aries squares your Midheaven while Jupiter conjuncts it, meaning promotions arrive with heavy responsibility—you’ll get the title, but proving yourself takes all summer. Mars in Libra trines your 6th House health sector, so channel that fiery energy into structured fitness routines or workplace advocacy projects. Mark July 15th when Pluto sextiles your Sun for a soul-level awakening, July 22nd when Mars sextiles Neptune for creative clarity, and July 31st when Jupiter conjvents your career ruler for a breakthrough. Avoid signing any major contracts before the 20th—this is your month to build legacy, not gamble on shortcuts. Your destiny is writing you a promotion letter; open the envelope and read it carefully.
